fields.given: a signed-in team member on the new poll page
fields.when: they enter 1 option, then 9 options, then 3 options and press Start
fields.then: 1 and 9 options are rejected with the message "Add 2 to 8 places" and 3 options create an open poll

fields.given: an open poll and its link on a phone browser
fields.when: a voter opens the link and taps one place
fields.then: the vote is saved after the second tap and the page shows "Vote saved"

fields.given: an open poll with votes from 3 people
fields.when: a voter who is not the organizer views the poll
fields.then: the page shows vote counts per place and no voter names

fields.given: a closed poll with votes from 3 people
fields.then: each place lists the names of the people who voted for it
its status is closed at 12:10:00 and new votes are rejected

fields.given: a voter who voted for place A in an open poll
fields.then: the poll counts 1 vote for B and 0 votes for A from that voter

fields.given: a poll that closes at 12:10:00 for a team of 5
fields.then: 5 reminder emails are sent, one to each team member
5 emails containing the poll link are sent

fields.given: a closed poll where places A and B each have 3 votes
fields.then: the organizer is asked to pick A or B, and the other places are not offered
